attempts.bug_summary: The generated NotIn predicate cases are emitted through the alternate helper mode instead of the standard mode. This changes the generated handling for NotIn predicates while leaving the other predicate families unchanged.

attempts.bug_summary: The generated greater-than-or-equal predicate cases are emitted as if they may produce multiple results, unlike the other inequality predicates. This changes filtering behavior for repeated or nested column structures where result aggregation depends on that setting.

attempts.bug_summary: The generated NotIn visitor cases are emitted with the multiple-results mode enabled, unlike the other set-membership predicates. This can alter evaluation for repeated or multi-valued column data while leaving ordinary scalar cases unchanged.
